tests.name: ordinary_calls_are_complete_first_order_calls_in_both_source_paths
tests.desired: A complete pair(1,q) call checks in finite loading and common selected preparation; selected client instantiation/elaboration remains preparation only.
tests.rejections: pair(1) and pair(q) are whole-call arity errors. A lexical ordinary Bit named pair is not a callable and reports the callee-name type error.
tests.expected_spans: Original half-open bytes: complete partial-call expression or the final local callee name.

tests.name: nested_quantum_environments_cannot_be_reused_as_callables_or_providers
tests.desired: Environments (Bit,(Q<Unit>,Unit)) and (Bit,(Q<Unit>,Q<Bit>)) remain linear, including a zero-width owner. Active and spent local operator bindings cannot be ordinary callees or static operation providers.
tests.rejections: Callable/static-provider use reports a located name type error before concrete lowering. Duplicating env reports consumed ownership at its second occurrence.
tests.expected_spans: Final operator-name occurrence or second env occurrence, in untouched source bytes.

tests.name: reusing_a_static_formal_composes_actions_without_duplicating_its_live_owner
tests.desired: then_op(U,U) may reuse a static formal while its application consumes/returns one quantum owner. Common source checking retains principal Unitary; only finite materialization/native acceptance is executed by this target.
tests.independent_oracle: Quarter=diag(1,i), Quarter^2=Z. Acting on one half of (|00>+|11>)/sqrt(2) yields (|00>-|11>)/sqrt(2). Measuring both halves in X gives outcomes 01 and 10, each with probability 1/2; all other outcomes zero.
tests.numerical_comparison: Distribution keys and total mass compared to the independently specified probabilities at 1e-12; this is a numerical conformance observation, not an exact proof discharge.
tests.negative_control: Two applications U(q),U(q) over the original q reject at the second q with ownership code in both source paths.
